reviewer_spec.description: Claude Sonnet 5 as an agent in Claude Code (claude -p): one fresh session per paper in a folder holding only that paper, with the read-only file tools and no web access. Effort set to high, the Messages API default, to match sonnet5; Claude Code's defaults otherwise.

input_spec.description: The same as fulltext, except that the dataset's extracted full text is a file, paper.txt, in the reviewer's working folder instead of being in the message, for an agent to open and search with its tools. Only claude-code reviewers can be given it.
